aliases: Strength Path Giant Hand Myriad Self First Style Giant Hand

summary.text: Myriad Self Giant Hand is Fang Yuan's strength path immortal killer move. It forms huge hands, distinct from the Myriad Self phantom army.

claims.text: At Tai Qiu, Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move Myriad Self first style, giant hand. Self Strength Immortal Gu sits at the center of a light lump that joins his strength path phantom army, and a hundred group strength Gu enter the lump. A strength path giant hand appears, pulls the air for dozens of meters, pushes a bull shaped desolate beast aside, grips and traps thunder shuttle Immortal Gu, then punches at Zhuo Zhan.

The giant hand’s design is influenced by formless hands, but the two differ: giant hand is a strength path killer move, while formless hand is theft path essence that can capture Immortal Gu; giant hand can only immobilize them for a short time. Activating with twenty thousand strength path phantoms already pushes Fang Yuan’s immortal zombie arm to its limit, with tendons, muscles, bones, and arteries torn, then recovering through the zombie body’s regeneration.

Prolonged use of strength path giant hands under Myriad Self strains his arms toward exploding into meat paste. The hands are powerful but slow, so trapping fast Gu Immortals with them is extremely difficult.

In Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan shouts Myriad Self giant hand, rise, and activates the immortal killer move. Four of eight strength path hands grab the sides of Dang Hun Mountain and the other four lift the base, raising the mountain tens of meters from the ground. Lifting is much easier than before, not only because he uses eight hands, but because he has already fused Pulling Mountain Immortal Gu into the killer move Myriad Self as a second core beside Self Strength. The eight hands then bring the mountain into Tai Bai Yun Sheng’s immortal aperture.

At the impassable dunes, a giant hand grabs a weakened hidden sand spider queen through the sandstorm. Seven more strength path giant hands emerge, and five rank six Gu Immortals of Xiao clan were routed in panic. After the merging of Pulling Mountain as a second Immortal Gu into myriad self giant hand, its might has greatly increased and has even more power against earth path desolate beasts like hidden sand spider queens.
Fang Yuan fused pulling water Immortal Gu into the killer move myriad self. At this point, myriad self had three strength path cores.

After adding Pulling Mountain and Pulling Water, Fang Yuan’s strength path giant hand had grown rapidly in strength. A strength path giant hand appears and grabs a golden bell; grasping hard is enough to break the bell.

In a duel, Fang Yuan grabs with a strength path giant hand. Zheng Ling feels he can block myriad self giant hand completely, then Fang Yuan uses all of his core Immortal Gu at once and the hand starts breaking the light path defense. Zheng Ling stacks a second defensive immortal killer move. Fang Yuan later sends seven other strength path giant hands at the feathermen, then squashes Zheng Ling into meat paste with the hands after poisoning him.

A strength path giant hand grabs Xue Song Zi. Ice armor forms on him and cracks under the grip. He detonates the armor, and the grabbing hand is pushed back. He flies out. A second hand slaps him into meat paste, because the armor has just broken and cannot be recast immediately.

Inside ancient battle formation Heavenly Giant Solor in Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan names the immortal killer move Myriad Self Giant Hand as a trump card. Four arms of the silver giant slam down, four strength path hands hit the ground, and the Gu Immortals in the formation expend a hundred beads of immortal essence. Amplified by the battle formation, strength path giant hand’s power reaches an unprecedented level: it gravely injures He Lang Zi, claps Immortal Gu House Dark Prison into a cracked, smoking shape, and forces Qin Bai Sheng to interrupt his Gu collection and dodge. Fang Yuan turns pale, sweats, and can barely stand from backlash after over-exerting himself.
Fang Yuan later judges that in that whole battle he generally did not use his full strength, and only at the last juncture did he display myriad self giant hand.

Because Pulling Water is already fused into strength path giant hand, the hand enters a lake without raising waves as the water parts, then holds a struggling dragonfish like an iron structure while Fang Yuan pulls it out.

When he fights a hidden essence turtle, he does not exert his full strength and rarely uses his Immortal Gu. He has used myriad self giant hand in many situations already and prefers not to expose it, in case other sects have preparations involving investigative Immortal Gu.

At Tai Qiu, using sword escape Immortal Gu to close the distance, Fang Yuan casts this move behind the second ancient eagle hound; the giant hand slams it down out of the air, and its fall is greatly mitigated by the giant grass covering the ground there. Earlier in the same fight one giant hand knocks a desolate beast level eagle hound unconscious, and ten or so hands then strike the first ancient eagle hound to death. Strength path giant hand carries rank seven battle strength, which makes one hand enough to knock a desolate beast level eagle hound unconscious but not enough against an ancient one.

A Myriad Self phantom army breaks apart against Heavenly Lord Bai Zu’s desolate beast wolf clones; the army has quantity but lacks quality, and conceals Fang Yuan’s true body more than it fights. He then uses Myriad Self Giant Hand. After he uses myriad self first style, the situation changes. Against the strength path giant hand, the wolves can barely resist.

While retrieving Western Desert Zombie Alliance’s inheritance, Fang Yuan sends a giant hand at Fairy Cui Bo and Three Feather Boy; her green acid corrodes the hand by twenty percent, but it keeps the other eighty percent of its power and, under his manipulation, still turns on her.

On Cloud Cover Continent in Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan tests the named move: a giant hand slams the cloud soil with rank seven attacking power, shatters the surroundings, and leaves a handprint several meters deep after the super immortal formation’s silver light is destroyed. In the past, to use myriad self giant hand he first had to activate Myriad Self and store countless strength path phantoms in his immortal aperture, then use Group Strength Gu to unleash strength path giant hand. Phantoms could not be stored long, so the move was unusable in unexpected fights or ambushes. After refining myriad self Immortal Gu, he modifies myriad self giant hand to use that Immortal Gu as the core with some Group Strength Gu as supplementary mortal Gu, fewer than thirty Gu worms in total. Self Strength is no longer the core, though he could add it again to increase strength. The current hand has rank seven power but is not at the peak, limited by his sovereign immortal body’s strength path dao marks. He has only started this modification after changing the core, and still sees room to add mortal Gu for speed or soul path Immortal Gu so the hand can capture souls.
